challenges.name: nominal replay
challenges.purpose: Prove the clean-room verifier reproduces the published bounded baseline result.

challenges.name: outer package digest tamper
challenges.purpose: Demonstrate that the verifier rejects a package whose outer integrity seal does not match its contents.

challenges.name: trial record binding tamper after outer reseal
challenges.purpose: Show that recomputing the outer package digest cannot conceal a changed source record with a stale record binding.

challenges.name: embedded trial Evidence Object tamper after outer reseal
challenges.purpose: Require the verifier to compare the embedded Evidence Object with an independently reconstructed projection rather than trusting the outer seal.

challenges.name: dependency edge removal after outer reseal

mutation.selection_rule: remove any existing edge and preserve all other package content

challenges.purpose: Demonstrate exact reconstruction of evidence dependencies, including raw evidence and acceptance-to-trial relationships.

challenges.name: verification receipt mutation after outer reseal
challenges.purpose: Require independent consequence-custody replay rather than acceptance of the package's stored verifier receipt.

challenges.name: observability claim strengthening after outer reseal
challenges.purpose: Prove that a package cannot promote bounded recorded observations into an objective physical-truth claim.
